problems.name: Overlapping buffers cut each other: 16,303 buffers became 1.86 million pieces at 100 m
Distances simplified differently: 85% and 88% of pieces deleted at 250 and 500 m, none at 100 m
100 m master table spelled IDs differently, so neither semi-arid ecoregion joined (48% of the 100 m area)
342,254 Plains slivers never sent to Earth Engine: the shapefile hit the 2 GB limit
IDs differ between 100, 250 and 500 m, so distances cannot be compared
No Railroad Commission field is a unique line ID
Buffers and simplifying done in latitude and longitude, not an equal-area projection
Second index is MNDWI, a water index, not NDWI for plant moisture
No pixel or image count behind each value; 158,940 slivers came back blank
Pixels read on a grid in degrees, not Sentinel-2's own grid
One season only, March to May 2025
No reference area to compare against
Map shows NDWI at 100 m but NDVI at 250 and 500 m
No leak records were used, so leaks were inferred, never measured
